profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer (DevOps)
profile.summary:
As a technical leader, I design and operate scalable software development platforms that support more than 13,000 developers 24x7. A major area of focus is GitHub Enterprise Server administration and platform architecture, where I lead capacity planning, performance optimization, and resilience engineering to support rapid growth in developer activity. With the rise of agentic AI, I am focused on preparing GitHub platforms for a 10x increase in load, including higher volumes of repository activity, automation workflows, API traffic, CI/CD integration, and service-to-service operations. I design solutions that scale both vertically and horizontally across applications, instances, and supporting services to ensure performance, availability, and operational stability at enterprise scale.
I also bring broad experience in designing scalable solutions for large enterprise systems, leading legacy source code management migrations to Git-based platforms, and supporting complex infrastructure across virtualization, systems administration, networking, storage, and disaster recovery. My background also includes infrastructure design for Industry 4.0 smart factory environments, where reliability, integration, and scale are critical.
Expertise Areas
GitHub Enterprise Server Administration
Scalable Enterprise Platform Architecture
GitHub Capacity Planning and Performance Optimization
Platform Scaling for 10x Agentic AI-Driven Load
Legacy Source Code Migration to Git-Based Platforms
Virtualization
Systems Administration
Cisco Networking
Enterprise Storage
Disaster Recovery Planning
Industry 4.0 Smart Factory Infrastructure

Received four awards
Excellence@EMC Gold Award 
Excellence@EMC Silver Award
Excellence@EMC Bronze Awards

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Implemented Git based SCM tools solutions as Software as a service to EMC global business units 
•	Architect multi sites failover solutions for SCM Git tools to minimize the downtime or restore time
•	Architected and implemented secure high availability infrastructure for production, development and testing environments of source control management solutions
•	Setup prove of concept environment of high availability Github enterprise, Git based Perforce environment including Perforce, Gitfusion and Gitswarm and demonstrate to EMC internal global business units
•	Help solve business needs with technology by evaluating different technology options and vendor products
•	Migrating customers Git/SVN repositories to either Github enterprise or Git based Perforce (Gitswarm mirror with Perforce via Gitfusion)
•	Troubleshoot repository related issues such as pull, push and branching..etc
•	Configure Linux virtual machines for SCM tools deployment.

positions.title: Principal Data Center Engineer
positions.description:
•	Provide level3 system administration functions in mixed environment (more than 10,000 Linux and Windows VMs in multiple data centers including mission critical VNX platform code build production data center).
•	Support daily operation by creating and troubleshooting Windows and Linux VMs and resolve storage related issues and VM templates management.
•	Support VMware EXSi 5.5 hosts by configuring host HA, DRS, datastore cluster and admission control.
•	Provide unified storage solution with EMC VNX7600 and 8000 series arrays for different data centers including capacity planning, disk provision, fast cache configuration, auto tiering storage pool and raid group creation, LUN provision, and create storage group for ESXI hosts. 
•	Design and implement agent and agentless Nagios monitoring tool to monitor Windows, Linux and Unix VM and physical servers in multiple data centers.
•	SAN management including zoning, SAN switch configuration and upgrade.

positions.title: Senior Network/System Engineer
positions.description:
•	Professional working experience on Cisco 2900/3750/MDS9000 series switches, Cisco wireless Controller, Cisco IE 3000 switches and Rockwell Stratix 8000/5700,  and Palo Alto firewall)
•	Experience with STP, VLAN Trunking, EtherChannel, VPN tunnel with IPSEC and routing protocols such as EIGRP,OSFP, HSRP, RIP,BGP.etc
•	Experience in network LAN/WAN deployment, including IP Addressing and troubleshooting, deploy and support more than 100 Cisco Layer 3 switches and configure/manage over 40+ data and voice VLANs
•	Act as a lead engineer designed/implemented and support a brand new infrastructure (fully redundant high speed network backbone, VMware virtual infrastructure, storage, DMZ, firewall and Windows 2008 R2 Active Directory Service) to support a 15 million dollar project
•	Design, install, configure VMware ESXi vSphere 4 and 5 with standard vSwitch and distributed vSwitch environments with Virtual Center management using the technologies DRS, HA, Resource allocation , vMotion, FT and alarm management.
•	Design, support 99.999% hardware up time for SQL server and Vmware hosts. 
•	Experience with SAN Configuration and Implementation, Storage Components like Internal storage, Attached storages, SAN Switches, HBA, LUN & Mapping, RAID groups, volume Groups and performance monitoring.
•	Management, planning, and deployment of over 200 virtual servers in Vmware ESXi 4.1/5.0 environment and 50-60 physical rack mounted servers
•	Professional working experience with EMC Avamar backup application and disaster recovery for all physical\virtual servers.
•	Experience in Active Directory, GPOs, DNS, WINS, DHCP, File & Print Server, IIS (Web Server), FTP, Terminal Server, NAT, Microsoft Clustering in Windows based server environment.
•	Professional Working Experience on HP Servers ProLiant(DL360/380/580, ML580), Servers, and DELL Power Edge Servers(2950/610/710/720)
•	Manage local desktop support team and provide 24x7 support in a fast paced, high pressure environment
